_comment: Linux (PR feat/linux-e2e, measured under Xvfb + openbox on ubuntu, release build, 20-60 s idle): binary 24 MB; normal open 555 MB RSS / 171 MB private (freewheel + WebKitWebProcess + WebKitNetworkProcess); tray 243 MB RSS / 49 MB private, the WebKitNetworkProcess stays (8.6 MB private), the web process goes; simulate open 865 / 305; idle CPU 0.8-1.7 % of one core; disk < 0.1 MB. RSS counts the shared GTK/WebKit libraries, so it is not comparable to Windows' working set. Budgets are those plus a margin; MB = MiB.
